leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the contain property to isolate a component's layout and style calculations
Configure content-visibility to optimize rendering performance for off-screen content
Implement contain-intrinsic-size to maintain layout stability with content-visibility
Construct a multi-section layout that demonstrates containment benefits
Manipulate scroll behavior to observe content-visibility optimizations in action
Integrate contain and content-visibility properties in a responsive design context
Initialize a performance comparison between standard and optimized rendering approaches
